title: V32 anonymous signal-time chart annotations
description: One outcome-blind annotation batch. Labels may co-occur. NONE_CLEAR is deliberately absent because the finalizer derives it only when all five labels are false.

BASE_COMPRESSION.description: A bounded base or visibly compressed price/turnover structure exists at or before the signal bar.

ORDERLY_PRICE_DISCOVERY.description: The visible signal-time path shows orderly price discovery, such as a coherent advance or progressive higher structure.

HIGH_TURNOVER_LOW_PRICE_DISPLACEMENT.description: Turnover is visibly elevated while contemporaneous price displacement remains modest.

MATURE_EXTENSION_OR_TERMINAL_SPIKE.description: The signal-time structure is already mature or extended, or ends in a terminal-looking price/turnover spike.

DOWNTREND_OR_BREAKDOWN.description: The visible path is a downtrend, failed repair, or structural breakdown at the signal bar.

evidence.description: A short, single-line observation based only on the anonymous signal-time chart.
